metadata.description: Praxis: requirements, architecture, implementation and verification as one local workflow. Install the 'praxis' plugin for the full set, or a single role.

plugins.name: praxis
plugins.description: The complete Praxis set: Runtime plus BA, Architect, Developer and Quality roles. Add this one plugin; the rest install as its dependencies.

plugins.name: praxis-runtime
plugins.description: Praxis Runtime: the local MCP server (praxis_* tools) used by every role. Installed automatically with any role plugin. Claude Desktop Chat uses the separate praxis-runtime.mcpb.

plugins.name: praxis-ba
plugins.description: Business analysis skills, including local capture without Jira.

plugins.name: praxis-architect
plugins.description: Architecture decisions. Approving a decision does not confirm story behavior.

plugins.name: praxis-developer
plugins.description: Implementation skills for accepted work packages.

plugins.name: praxis-quality
plugins.description: Verification skills. Verdicts stay separate from story confirmation.
